about:
Chicago Medical Engineering is based in Elmhurst, Illinois. Founded in 2019 by a team of engineers who recognized the importance of calibrated, high-performing medical imaging equipment, the company began as a response to a market gap for reliable pre-owned capital equipment and service.

The company supplies pre-owned medical imaging systems and parts—over 1,190 items across 16 equipment categories including CT scanners (362 systems), MRI scanners (77), cath/angio labs (63), portable X-ray (40), ultrasound transducers (32), and digital mammography units (23). It also provides service and maintenance for imaging and radiation therapy equipment: preventive maintenance, emergency repairs, calibration, compliance assurance, linear accelerator service, and part repair/exchange. A global network of engineers handles de‑installation, inspection, installation, and testing. The firm offers flexible warranty, leasing, and asset‑management options.

Customers include hospitals, outpatient diagnostic centers, radiation oncology clinics, and radiology departments worldwide. Testimonials cite a radiation oncology director, a VP of healthcare procurement, and a lead biomedical engineer. The company serves facilities needing turnkey clinical and diagnostic solutions, from equipment sourcing to installation and ongoing support.

The founders started the business to address the marketing gap and ensure calibrated medical equipment delivers performing results. The company emphasizes project coordination from start to finish, buying confidence through inspected and de‑installed systems shipped by their own engineers, and regulatory compliance with The Joint Commission, DNV Healthcare, NFPA 99, and radiation safety boards.

name: Chilton Furniture
old_description: We offer a unique collection of designs celebrating natural materials, New England aesthetics, and quality craftsmanship.
about:
Chilton Furniture traces its roots to 1885 when Chilton Manufacturing Co. was established in Portland, Maine, producing paints, varnishes, and industrial coatings. The business was acquired by the Martens family in 1936, shifting focus to stains and finishes for furniture makers. In 2014, the Levin family took ownership, refocusing the company on exclusive furniture designs crafted from domestically sourced North American hardwoods. Today, it operates as a family-owned brand headquartered in Portland, with a flagship showroom there and a second location in Freeport.

The company designs contemporary, functional furniture—including seating, tables, storage, beds, and accessories—and collaborates with a network of independent makers in Maine and the Midwest to handcraft each piece from premium domestic hardwoods such as cherry, maple, walnut, and white oak. All materials are sourced in the United States. Chilton provides nationwide delivery and backs its products with a lifetime warranty for the original owner.

Chilton serves both direct consumers and trade professionals, including interior designers and retailers, through a trade partner program that offers discounts and benefits. Its furniture is marketed for residential use, with collections such as Shaker, Hudson, and Maine Made appealing to customers seeking handcrafted, domestically produced pieces.

The brand emphasizes its commitment to enduring craftsmanship, domestic sourcing, and New England design heritage. The lifetime warranty reflects confidence in the durability of its furniture, while the maker-partnership model aims to sustain regional woodworking traditions.

name: Cincinnati Wood Collaborative
old_description: We have been accredited by the BBB since 2018 and strive to maintain the principles of quality, value, and integrity, and to practice these principles in all our affairs.
about:
Cincinnati Wood Collaborative, based in Cincinnati, Ohio, has been operating since 2018. The business is led by David Bach, who heads a crew specializing in custom woodworking.

The shop provides custom woodworking for projects of any size, with a focus on complete millwork packages for restaurants, bars, and breweries. Work includes fabrication and installation of custom millwork for commercial builds and renovations.

The company serves the hospitality sector, delivering millwork for dining and drinking establishments in the Cincinnati area. Projects have included custom bar tops, seating, and architectural millwork for breweries and restaurants.

The collaborative emphasizes sustainable practices, sourcing lumber exclusively from certified Master Logging Companies that adhere to Ohio Forestry Association standards. It also holds BBB accreditation since 2018, underscoring a commitment to quality, value, and integrity, while prioritizing local material sourcing and partnerships with other small businesses in the community.

name: Cinnamon Metals
old_description: Serving commercial and residential Roofing, Masonry, and Green Roofing Contractors
about:
Cinnamon Metals was founded in 2005 when a Manassas, Virginia roofing contractor, frustrated by weeks-long lead times for simple sheet metal orders, began fabricating parts in his home garage with the help of his wife, Cinnamon. The operation grew steadily and relocated to a dedicated shop in Springfield, Virginia in July 2014.

The company operates as a full-service custom metal fabricator, specializing in roofing, green roofing, and masonry products. Its capabilities include sheet metal fabrication, 3D product design, shop drawing and cut sheet creation, manufacturing consulting, and laser welding. Equipment includes a shear and computerized brake, a CNC turret punch (added 2019), a CNC press brake (added 2020), and laser welding capability (added 2021).

Cinnamon Metals serves commercial and residential roofing, masonry, and green roofing contractors, as well as landscaping and general construction firms. Its product lines cover commercial roofing panels, water control systems, masonry flashings, green roofing components, and custom fabrications.

The business was built on eliminating long wait times for contractors, emphasizing quick, reliable, and quality fabrication. It is an authorized fabricator manufacturing to ANSI/SPRI ES-1 standards and a member of the National Roofing Contractors Association (NRCA).

Circle City Metalworks is a metal fabrication shop based in the Irvington neighborhood of Indianapolis, Indiana. Founded in 2020 by Ryan Mullin, the business began as a small shop offering custom metalwork for residential and commercial clients.

The shop specializes in custom metal fabrication, including handrails, tables, signage, and security products. Using plasma cutting, welding, and finishing capabilities, the team handles projects from small residential pieces to larger commercial installations such as the Southport High School project noted as their largest to date.

Customers include homeowners seeking custom handrails and tables, property managers needing apartment complex signage, and institutional clients such as Southport High School in Perry Township. The shop also produces security-focused products and custom gift items.

The company emphasizes custom creations tailored to each client's vision, summarized by the motto "You dream it, we make it." The founder has highlighted a commitment to bringing unique metalwork ideas to life for the Indianapolis area.

name: Circuit Breaker Source | Circuit Breaker Buyers
old_description: Get Amped Up For Unbeatable Deals – Buy And Sell Your Electrical Items With Us Today!
about:
Circuit Breaker Source operates from Norco, California, and was founded in 2015. The company buys and sells new, used, obsolete, and surplus circuit breakers and related electrical equipment.

The business handles a range of breaker types including molded case, low-voltage, air, vacuum, insulated case, and panelboard models, along with transformers, panels, safety switches, motor control centers, and isolator switches. It also provides repair and testing, system upgrade and design, refurbishing to extend breaker life, supply and replacement, emergency response, and cleaning and lubrication services. Operations are nationwide; no facility size or headcount is disclosed.

Customers include electrical contractors with leftover project material, electrical distributors with slow-moving inventory, industrial facilities undergoing modernization, and construction companies with surplus stock. The company evaluates breakers by manufacturer, model, ratings, condition, quantity, and demand, and accepts single units or bulk lots.

The firm states it is certified by state and federal law and emphasizes fair pricing with no hidden fees, fast shipping, and a diverse inventory. Its stated vision is to lead the industry with quality products, services, and innovative solutions, while its mission focuses on safe electrical equipment and a sustainable supply chain.

name: Circuit Design Specialties Inc.
old_description: Best Circuit Design in the industry. Unparalleled craftsmanship & attention to detail.
about:
Circuit Design Specialties operates from Plano, Texas, as a woman-owned business founded by Randel Stewart, who serves as CEO. The company marks over three decades in the electronics industry, with Stewart bringing more than 33 years of experience to the operation.

The firm provides complete electronic and mechanical assembly services from its own manufacturing facility. Its capabilities span PCB layout—including high-layer-count, blind and buried vias, flex, rigid-flex, mixed-material, and high-speed impedance-controlled designs—PCB manufacturing, PCB assembly, cable and wiring harness assembly, and full box-build integration. An in-house engineering team handles new product development from concept through prototype to production, leveraging the manufacturing side to design for testability and cost reduction.

CDS serves industrial, medical, military, and government customers, ranging from small businesses to medium and large companies across the United States. The company highlights experience building cables and assemblies for industrial, military, and medical applications specifically.

The company emphasizes its differentiation as an electronic design service that owns its manufacturing facility, which it says yields significant cost savings over traditional contract engineering firms. It also guarantees fixed-price PCB layout quotes, uses accredited suppliers with verified component availability, and inspects every board before shipment.

name: Clarus Medical
old_description: Clarus Medical manufactures, and maintains medical devices that assist in saving lives, minimizing patient trauma and reducing medical costs.
about:
Clarus Medical, headquartered in Minneapolis, Minnesota, has accumulated over three decades of experience in the design and manufacture of small-diameter, high-quality medical endoscopes. The company originated with a focus on creating precision instruments that help save lives, minimize patient trauma, and lower healthcare costs.

Today, Clarus Medical produces a portfolio that includes intubation scopes, minimally invasive spine devices, inspection borescopes, neuroendoscopes, and fiberoptic inspection scopes. All products are manufactured in an ISO 13485 certified cleanroom facility, and the company extends its capabilities to private label and OEM manufacturing for other medical device firms.

The primary market is the medical industry, where Clarus Medical collaborates with medical companies as an OEM supplier. Its devices support airway management, spinal surgery, neuroendoscopy, and industrial inspection, serving hospitals, surgical centers, and medical device manufacturers.

The company differentiates itself through its ISO 13485 certified cleanroom environment, its three-decade track record in small-diameter endoscope engineering, and its ability to provide private label and OEM solutions tailored to partner specifications.

name: Classic Plastics Corporation
old_description: Classic Plastics Corp is a custom plastics manufacturer with more than 30-years of proven expertise in polymer engineering, custom fabrication, printing & fulfillment. As the vertically integrated partner behind Heavy Duty Body Bag, our end‑to‑end capabilities allow us to deliver this high‑quality, spec‑driven product for industries that demand compliance, reliability & consistency.
about:
Classic Plastics Corporation operates from Shorewood, Illinois, where it has accumulated over three decades of experience in polymer engineering and custom fabrication. The company serves as the vertically integrated manufacturer behind the Heavy Duty Body Bag product line.

The company produces a range of mortuary and containment products including leak-resistant body bags, cremation-safe bags, alkaline hydrolysis bags, mortuary garments, and specialty plastic items. Its capabilities span custom fabrication and tooling, advanced material selection, private label services, and in-house printing and fulfillment. Materials processed include vinyl, polypropylene, polyethylene, bioplastics derived from corn and tapioca starches, PEVA, PVA, and scrim-reinforced PE-SCRIM, with thicknesses from 6–8 mil for standard duty up to 16 reinforced handles on super heavy-duty grades. Custom orders typically require a minimum of 1,000 pieces, while stock items ship within one to two business days.

Classic Plastics serves the death care, healthcare, medical and scientific, government and public safety, and veterinary sectors. Direct customers include funeral homes, medical examiners, hospitals, morgues, anatomy labs, organ and tissue donor networks, coroners, police and fire departments, the U.S. Army, veterinary hospitals, wildlife and farm management facilities, and funeral supply distributors. The company also sells through a distributor network for mortuary garments.

The company emphasizes its vertically integrated, end-to-end model as a differentiator, enabling spec-driven production for compliance-heavy industries. It highlights pioneering work in custom bioplastics, offering chlorine-free, Burn Wise compliant options for clean cremation and alkaline hydrolysis, along with private labeling and in-house printing for branded professional offerings.
